summary: Openverse live-run fixes. (2) acquisition.fetch_to maps HTTP 429 to RATE_LIMITED (in RETRYABLE_CODES); all other non-200 statuses keep HTTP_STATUS. (3) ASSETS.md section 8.8 records the 2026-11-17 live runs 1-3 as REPORTED with VERIFIED limited to what was exercised and NOT-verified listed. Nothing here promotes M-AST-02 to verified or complete; no live payload or media committed; tests use no network.
